robotsTxtObservation.privateSurfaces: Private and admin surfaces are NOT disallowed in robots.txt; they rely on noindex meta plus the X-Robots-Tag header, which is the correct order of operations.

public/robots.txt disallows /api/. Robots.txt is a crawl hint, not an access control, and is not used as a substitute for noindex on HTML pages or for authorisation on the API.

items.appliesTo: Static assets: /uploads/* and the hashed build assets under the browser bundle
items.notes: Static files are not pages. They are neither sitemapped nor redirected, and they must not be used to host a second copy of indexable page content.
